lead_fa: بازی Protection Warrior تانک اصلی وارکرافت است: شمشیر و سپر با سبک تهاجمی که هرچه بیشتر بجنگی قوی‌تر می‌شوی. دفاع تو روی Block سوار است و [[Shield Block]] قوی‌ترین مکانیزم کاستن دمیج بازی است؛ با [[Spell Reflection]] هم ضعف‌هایت را در Mythic+ به قدرت تبدیل می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Mountain Thane]] که برچسب Best منبع را برای Raid و Mythic+ دارد و [[Colossus]] با [[Demolish]] که Best Delves را دارد.

strengths: Strong offensive cooldowns that can be used frequently
Short cooldowns on most defensive abilities which can cover many mechanics if spaced out correctly
Heroic Leap and Charge provide excellent mobility
Shield Block is arguably the single most overpowered form of mitigation in the game
Spell Reflection turns weaknesses into strengths in Mythic+
Excellent defensive consistency: 100% Shield Block uptime is possible for smooth damage intake
weaknesses: Susceptible to damage spikes if Shield Block falls off or you turn your back to enemies
Self-healing does not scale with damage taken like Vengeance Demon Hunters or Blood Death Knights
Managing defensive cooldowns takes a high degree of skill, awareness and encounter knowledge
Weak against unblockable and non-reflectable damage such as frequent DoTs, requiring advanced cooldown planning

buffs: Devastating Focus now also increases Execute damage to the primary target (was Revenge only)
Ravager redesigned: no longer increases Revenge and Thunder Clap damage; instead enemies it damages take 50% increased damage from your Bleeds for 12 seconds
Revenge updated: successful dodges, parries AND auto-attacks can make the next Revenge free (was only dodges and parries); damage increased by 20%
Fueled by Violence now heals for 125% of Bleed damage dealt (was 110%)
Ignore Pain absorb amount increased by 25%
Brutal Vitality now adds 10% of damage dealt to Ignore Pain (was 8%)
changes_12_1.note: Midnight 12.1 brings Protection Warrior some fantastic buffs overall, making Execute viable again and granting more Revenge procs plus defensive buffs. Midnight launch removed: Thunderous Roar, Uproar, Thunderous Words, Immovable Object, Piercing Challenge, Champion's Might and Seismic Reverberation; new talents include Phalanx, Javelineer, Battlefield Commander and Stance Mastery.

hero.recommendation: With current balancing the overall flow, rotational speed and Rage generation of Mountain Thane tend to outshine Colossus, and the tree is also favored defensively; it carries the Best tags for Raid and Mythic+. Colossus plays a slower rotation which might feel better or worse by preference and carries the Best tag for Delves. Both hero trees are competitive with one another in damage output and utility.
hero.mountain_thane: Harnesses the power of lightning and brings Storm Shield alongside its rotational benefits.
hero.colossus: Focuses on the raw power of your own muscles to deal considerable damage with the channeled Demolish; plays a slower rotation.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview and talent page (Pumps, updated 2026-10-13): Mountain Thane Best for Raid and Mythic+; Colossus Best for Delves.

concepts: React to Shield Slam procs: Shield Slam should always be used when ready since it generates the most rage, threat and damage and keeps the rotation flowing
Avoid Rage waste: keep Rage below the cap; you can always dump more into Ignore Pain
Utilize your cooldowns frequently: Avatar comes up roughly every minute, Demoralizing Shout comes up very often and Shield Wall smooths damage intake where necessary
A fast paced rotation with many frequent procs; build and spend as much Rage as possible to cycle cooldowns faster
Nothing changes significantly from single target to AoE: the rotation naturally AoEs
st_priority: Cast Thunder Clap on cooldown and to apply Rend
Spend excess Rage on Ignore Pain
Execute targets at or below 20% health (35% if you have the talent)
Use Impending Victory if you have low HP
rotation.aoe_note: The AoE priority is the same list: the rotation naturally AoEs through Thunder Clap, Revenge and Ravager.

cooldowns.Avatar: Gives a multitude of perks changed by talents; primarily increases all damage done and generally reduces the cooldown of Thunder Clap; cast on cooldown roughly every minute
cooldowns.Demoralizing Shout: Offensive-utility cooldown that comes up very often; use frequently
cooldowns.Shield Charge: One of the three main offensive cooldowns cycled on cooldown
cooldowns.Shield Wall: Big defensive used to smooth damage intake where necessary
cooldowns.Shield Block: The single most powerful mitigation mechanic in the game; maintain 100% uptime when taking melee damage
cooldowns.Ravager: Redesigned in 12.1: enemies it damages take 50% increased damage from your Bleeds for 12 seconds; the tier set reduces its cooldown by 30 seconds

rotation.hero_notes: Always be casting: missing 10-20% of your total casts by not mashing fast enough loses significant damage and rage generation which cascades into less resources, less CDR and less damage. Your casts do not have to be perfect, just make sure you are hitting something instead of mashing buttons that are not ready.
opener: Always Charge into combat and start cycling through cooldowns as fast as possible
pre_combat: Cast the group buff Battle Shout
Double check you are in the correct Stance
Consume food, flask and weapon oil

gear.gearing_rules: Rough guideline: Haste > Versatility = Critical Strike > Mastery; never neglect Strength since a substantial item level increase is generally worth it compared to optimized stats. Defensively Protection prefers Haste (faster rotation and rage generation) and Crit (parry on large pulls reduces damage taken); offensively all four secondaries are fairly close and vary with your stat allocation. Prot focuses on completing the tier set and picking up both offensive and defensive trinkets; trinket cooldown flexibility is high since Avatar is up very frequently. Sim with Raidbots.

mplus.hero_note: Mountain Thane carries the Best tags for Mythic+ this season with Colossus taking Delves. Spell Reflection lets you turn caster-heavy pulls into free damage reduction and Shield Block gives smooth melee intake across every pack.
tips: Maintain 100% Shield Block uptime against melee packs; it is the strongest mitigation in the game
Use Spell Reflection proactively on pack-wide casts
Dump excess Rage into Ignore Pain instead of letting it cap
Cycle Avatar, Demoralizing Shout and Shield Charge aggressively since they come back fast
Plan cooldowns ahead against unblockable DoT damage: pre-shield wall those windows
